ByteSize.description: A non-negative byte size using binary units where a suffix is present.
ByteSize.title: ByteSize

CommandHook.description: A hook that runs an executable, without a shell, inside the session's projection directory. Whatever it writes there is published with the projection. The command runs the tree it checks, so it executes unpublished changes.

id.description: Label shown with this hook. It is unique within `hooks`.
id.title: Id

argv.description: Executable followed by literal arguments. An absolute executable path is refused; a bare name resolves through the `PATH` of the merged environment the command runs with, and a relative path resolves below `working_directory` in the session projection. Rift performs no shell expansion.
argv.title: Argv

working_directory.description: Directory below the projection root in which the process starts. The empty path selects the root.

environment.description: Environment values added on top of the environment the server inherited. Rift starts the command directly, without a shell, and supplies its working directory separately.
environment.title: Environment

timeout_ms.description: Wall-clock limit before Rift terminates the process.
timeout_ms.title: Timeout Ms

output_limit_bytes.description: Captured prefix limit for each output stream. `CapturedText.total_bytes` reports the omitted size. The upper bound keeps one escaped hook result inside one bounded result.
output_limit_bytes.title: Output Limit Bytes

guarantees.description: Behavior or other properties this hook is intended to check. A passing result turns each declaration into `GuaranteeEvidence`; a failed result attaches a `ConfirmationRequirement` to the change.
guarantees.title: Guarantees

CommandHook.title: CommandHook

CommandHookChangedPaths.description: Whether Rift appends changed `ProjectPath` values to `argv` in byte order.
CommandHookChangedPaths.title: CommandHookChangedPaths

rift:enumDescriptions.all: Everything the adapter could see: the workspace, its dependencies, and the standard library.
rift:enumDescriptions.dependencies: Installed packages outside the workspace source.
rift:enumDescriptions.project: Every file in the workspace, dependencies left out.
rift:enumDescriptions.request: Only what this request asked for. The adapter answered the question put to it and claims nothing past it.

CoverageScope.description: What a completeness statement covers — everything the request asked for, one file, or a standing scope the answer holds over.
CoverageScope.title: CoverageScope

CoverageScopeKind.description: A standing scope identified by its name.
CoverageScopeKind.title: CoverageScopeKind

CoverageScopeUnit.description: One file. The claim holds for that path and says nothing about any other.

unit.description: The file the claim is about.

CoverageScopeUnit.title: CoverageScopeUnit

Duration.description: A non-negative duration with one explicit unit.
Duration.title: Duration

ExecutionConfig.description: Workspace enablement and limits for caller-provided code.

allow.description: Exact languages enabled for execute when their adapters advertise the execute operation. Empty disables caller-provided code.
allow.title: Allow

debug.description: Subset of allow enabled for debugging when all three debug operations are advertised. Empty disables debugging.
debug.title: Debug

max_code.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes in one CodeBlock.source.

max_timeout.description: Wall-clock bound applied to each execution and debugging evaluation.

max_output.description: Captured prefix bound applied separately to stdout and stderr.

max_concurrent.description: Evaluations admitted concurrently across the workspace.
max_concurrent.title: Max Concurrent

max_debug_sessions.description: Retained debugging sessions admitted across the workspace.
max_debug_sessions.title: Max Debug Sessions

debug_idle_timeout.description: Idle time before Rift stops a debugging session and releases its lease.

max_debug_frames.description: Stack frames one failed debugging evaluation may retain.
max_debug_frames.title: Max Debug Frames

max_debug_bindings.description: Arguments plus locals returned for one debug frame.
max_debug_bindings.title: Max Debug Bindings

max_debug_value.description: Captured UTF-8 bytes in each adapter-rendered debug binding value.

ExecutionConfig.title: ExecutionConfig

FileId.description:
Identity of one file in the session projection. The path after `rift://file/` is a
`ProjectPath` in canonical percent-encoding. The server re-validates the decoded path
wherever a `FileId` arrives, so the `ProjectPath` exclusions hold for every consumer,
whatever schema its implementation generated from.
FileId.title: FileId

GuaranteeKind.description: A property an action claims and must establish with scoped evidence when resolved.

rift:enumDescriptions.behavior_checked: A named static analysis or workspace hook checked a stated behavioral property. The evidence is limited to that named property and scope.
rift:enumDescriptions.bindings_preserved: Unchanged references in scope resolve to the same symbols before and after the action.
rift:enumDescriptions.references_updated: Every resolved reference in scope that should follow the operation now reaches its intended target.
rift:enumDescriptions.syntax_validated: The language parser accepts the affected source under the stated scope.

GuaranteeKind.title: GuaranteeKind

Hook.description:
One workspace hook from the workspace-root `rift.toml`, run inside the session's
projection each time a change applies. `type` selects how the hook runs; `command` is
the only type.
Hook.title: Hook

HookDeterminism.description: Whether an identical tree and environment are expected to produce the same result.
HookDeterminism.title: HookDeterminism

HookGuarantee.description: What a passing run of one configured hook establishes.

kind.description: Guarantee established when the hook passes.

scope.description: Source over which the hook checks the property.

detail.description: Exact property the hook checks and limits on interpreting a pass.
detail.title: Detail

HookGuarantee.title: HookGuarantee

HookKind.description: How workspace configuration presents this hook.
HookKind.title: HookKind

LanguageSelector.description: The TOML spelling of the same exact language pair represented by ``core.Language``.
LanguageSelector.title: LanguageSelector

ProjectPath.description:
One path below the workspace root, using forward slashes and UTF-8 in Unicode NFC — Rift
normalizes what it emits and what it accepts, and compares byte-for-byte. The empty path
names the root itself. Absolute paths, backslashes, control characters, empty segments, and
`.` or `..` segments are refused before the filesystem is touched. The limit is 1000 UTF-8
bytes, not characters. A workspace holding two entries whose NFC forms are equal fails the
read that touches them with `content_unavailable`.
ProjectPath.title: ProjectPath

ValidationConfig.description: Adapter validation reports required for projection changes and publication.

require.description: `available` requires every affected adapter that advertises validation; `none` requires no adapter reports; an explicit list requires those exact core.Language pairs.
require.title: Require
